llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization (filed with Initial List of Managers/Managing Members and State Business License)
llc.formation_notes: At formation an LLC also files the Initial List ($150) and pays the State Business License fee ($200), due no later than the last day of the month following filing of the articles; realistic start-up total about $425. No publication requirement.

annual_report.name: Annual List of Managers or Managing Members
annual_report.due: last day of the anniversary month of formation
annual_report.late_penalty: Annual list late penalty not verified; State Business License late penalty $100

state_tax_on_llc.name: State Business License fee
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every LLC (including single-member LLCs) and other non-corporate entities; corporations pay $500
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Paid with the initial and each annual list; renewal due last day of anniversary month; $100 late penalty.

state_tax_on_llc.name: Commerce Tax
state_tax_on_llc.applies: businesses (corporations, partnerships, sole proprietors, LLCs) with Nevada gross revenue over $4,000,000 in a fiscal year (July 1 - June 30)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Rate varies by NAICS industry category; return due 45 days after June 30 (Aug 14, 2026 for FY 2025-2026). Below $4M exempt. Credit of part of Commerce Tax against MBT.

state_tax_on_llc.name: Modified Business Tax (payroll)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: employers (general business) on gross wages after health-benefit deduction
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 1.17% since July 1, 2023; first $50,000 of wages per calendar quarter non-taxable (NRS 363B.110). Financial institutions 1.554% on all wages. Matters only if the LLC/S corp has payroll.

sources.title: Nevada SOS - State Business License FAQ
sources.quote: The State Business License Fee is $500 for Corporations, and $200 for all other business types.

sources.title: Nevada Department of Taxation - Commerce Tax
sources.quote: The Commerce Tax is imposed on businesses with a Nevada state gross revenue exceeding $4 million per fiscal year.

sources.title: Nevada Department of Taxation - Modified Business Tax
sources.quote: Tax rate for most General Business employers reduced to 1.17% from 1.378%.

sources.title: NRS Chapter 86 - Limited-Liability Companies
sources.quote: each annual list required by subsection 2, the limited-liability company shall pay to the Secretary of State a fee of $150

entity_level_taxes.name: State Business License fee
entity_level_taxes.notes: An S corporation formed as a Nevada corporation pays $500/year; an LLC electing S status pays $200.

entity_level_taxes.name: Commerce Tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: Only above $4M Nevada gross revenue; industry rates.

entity_level_taxes.name: Modified Business Tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: On owner-employee wages too, but first $50,000 of quarterly payroll is exempt.

sources.title: Nevada SOS - State Business License FAQ
sources.quote: The State Business License Fee is $500 for Corporations, and $200 for all other business types.

sources.title: Nevada Department of Taxation - Commerce Tax
sources.quote: Businesses below the $4 million threshold are exempt

sources.title: Nevada Department of Taxation - Modified Business Tax
sources.quote: The first $50,000 of wages remains non-taxable under NRS 363B.110.

estimated_tax.notes: Commerce Tax is an annual return (due 45 days after June 30); MBT is quarterly.

unemployment_2026.notes: 2.95% statutory new-employer rate plus 0.05% Career Enhancement Program = 3.00% effective. Wage base $45,400 for 2027.

notable: No personal or corporate income tax, but every LLC pays a $200 State Business License fee plus a $150 annual list each year (https://www.nvsos.gov/licensing/state-business-license/state-business-license-faq)
A Nevada corporation (including one taxed as an S corp) pays $500 for the State Business License vs $200 for an LLC (https://www.nvsos.gov/licensing/state-business-license/state-business-license-faq)
Commerce Tax only above $4 million Nevada gross revenue (https://tax.nv.gov/tax-types/commerce-tax/)
